label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Not counted: our browser engine could not press a visible control (its click waited and timed out), a fault on our side, not the shop's. The customer will shop here again.

reclassified.why: our browser engine could not press a visible control (its click waited and timed out), a fault on our side, not the shop's. The customer will shop here again.

findings.problem: After pressing Add to cart nothing visible or announced happened on the page itself; the button just became disabled and I had to guess the cart had opened. The confirmation text only appears at the very end of the cart dialog.

element.name: Add to cart Power Surge Mug

findings.problem: The Checkout button has a name with a leading icon character and plain-name or exact-name clicks both timed out repeatedly (4 tries), so I could not get from the cart to checkout at all.

With the cart drawer open, the header cart link is covered by a progress bar overlay, and closing and reopening the drawer only shows the same drawer with the same unreachable Checkout button; there is no separate cart page link.
The home page tree is extremely long with about 40 repeated unlabeled-purpose press logo links (same [name], [name], Yahoo names repeated many times), burying the content for a screen reader user.

element.name: Learn more about Retailer BB on [name].

findings.problem: Several product cards show a Quick Shop text that is not a button or link, and some cards (stir stick sets) have no Add to cart control, so the way to buy them is unclear.
